reader_summary.headline: We sit down with a16z General Partner Katherine Boyle to discuss investing in “American Dynamism”.
reader_summary.overview: We sit down with a16z General Partner Katherine Boyle to discuss investing in “American Dynamism”. Katherine has a fascinating background, beginning her career as a reporter at The Washington Post before entering the VC world first at Founders Fund. Her perspectives don’t fit neatly in any box — political, economic or otherwise — and we have a great conversation exploring them.
